name: @arcjet/transport
description: Transport mechanisms for the Arcjet protocol

scripts.test-runtime-bun: npm run build && HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:49219 bun test test/runtime/proxy.bun.test.ts
scripts.test-runtime-deno: npm run build && HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:49219 deno test --allow-all --no-check test/runtime/proxy.deno.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run api-report && npm run test-coverage
scripts.api-report: api-extractor run --config config/api-extractor.bun.json && api-extractor run --config config/api-extractor.deno.json && api-extractor run --config config/api-extractor.edge-light.json && api-extractor run --config config/api-extractor.index.json && api-extractor run --config config/api-extractor.workerd.json
scripts.api-report:update: api-extractor run --local --config config/api-extractor.bun.json && api-extractor run --local --config config/api-extractor.deno.json && api-extractor run --local --config config/api-extractor.edge-light.json && api-extractor run --local --config config/api-extractor.index.json && api-extractor run --local --config config/api-extractor.workerd.json
